subject: R shiny: uiOutput() does not work in conditionalPanel() at sidebarPanel?

messages.author: 697b680d95df20fd
messages.subject: R shiny: uiOutput() does not work in conditionalPanel() at sidebarPanel?
parts:
Hi guys,

I read many examples that have uiOutput() work in conditionalPanel() at sidebarPanel. But I just tried to incorporate it into my app, and it does not work. Here is an example. 

Any suggestion?

Thanks a lot for the help!

Ying

# server.R for test
library(shiny)
library(ggvis)

mydata <- data.frame(geneID=c("EGFR","EGFR","EGFR","EGFR","KRAS","KRAS","KRAS","KRAS","KRAS","BRAF","BRAF","NRAS"),
    probeID=c("E1_at","E2_at","E3_at","E4_at","K1_at","K2_at","K3_at","K4_at","K5_at","B1_at","B2_at","N1_at"),
    crosHyb=c(0,0,0,5,1,2,0,0,0,0,1,1)
                     )

shinyServer(function(input, output, session) {

probelist <- reactive({
    if (is.null(input$gene)) {return(NULL)}
    gene2probe <- mydata[grep(paste0("^",input$gene,"$"), mydata$geneID,ignore.case = TRUE, perl=TRUE), ]
    probesets <- paste(gene2probe$probeID, gene2probe$crosHyb, sep=" ::: index ")
                probesets
})

output$myui01 <- renderUI({
    selectizeInput(
      inputId = "probesMulti", 
      label = "Select a probe/probes:",
      multiple = TRUE,
      choices = probelist(),
      options = list(maxItems = 20, placeholder = "Pick a probe:")
    )
  })

output$myui02 <- renderUI({
    selectizeInput(
      inputId = "probeOne", 
      label = "Select only one probe:",
      multiple = FALSE,
      choices = probelist()
    )
  })       

output$mygene <- renderText({
            paste("Query gene is ", toupper(input$gene), ".", sep="")
        })

output$myprobe <- renderText({
            paste("Query gene is ", input$probeOne, ".", sep="")
        })

output$mypassage <- renderText({
            paste("Query gene is ", input$passages[1], " and ", input$passages[2], ".", sep="")
        })
})
